title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: FLAC -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Dolby B) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard mix captures a high‑energy second set with a smoking Samson and a heartfelt "All Over Now Baby Blue" encore.
ai_review.review: The upgraded sbd mix by Charlie Miller brings out the band’s excitement, delivering clear, crisp audio that lets listeners feel the crowd’s energy. The show shines especially in the second set – a blazing Samson intro (with Phil “bombing” on bass) and a moving All Over Now Baby Blue encore – while the first set remains solid. Minor flubs (notably in Truckin') are noted but do not detract from an overall exhilarating performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for both the upgraded soundboard quality and the show’s high energy; only a few low or neutral comments mention minor performance slips, so the combined show (70%) and recording (30%) assessment is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix that captures crowd energy; noted as a significant upgrade over previous releases. No major drop‑outs or muddiness, just occasional minor imperfections in the performance itself.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by a high‑energy second set that builds momentum and ends with an emotive encore, providing a satisfying arc.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work at the start of Samson is described as “bomb justice,” highlighting his powerful playing.
